items.summary: Ottawa is set to receive its first blast of winter, with “several hours” of freezing rain expected tonight and on Friday. Environment Canada has issued a yellow warning – freezing rain for Ottawa and parts of eastern Ontario.

items.title: Why an Ontario couple wants to return their EV and switch back to a gas-powered car
items.summary: A family in Oshawa say their first electric car has been a good vehicle, but they now have concerns that charging it could be potentially dangerous.

items.title: Ex-Conservative MP sues Liberal volunteer over alleged election campaign interference
items.summary: A former Conservative MP is suing a Liberal volunteer, accusing the man of creating fake websites in a "malicious" and "calculated" plan to interfere with his re-election prospects during the 2025 campaign.

items.title: Supreme Court of Canada to hear challenge of Ontario law central to Greenbelt dispute
items.summary: The Supreme Court of Canada has agreed to hear a developer’s constitutional challenge of an Ontario law at the heart of a dispute over land in a protected area known as the provincial Greenbelt.

items.title: Farmers demonstrate in Brussels against EU budget cuts
